name: Indurium
summary: In the Badlands, Martek the Exiled seeks metal samples for Fizzle's car. Indurium is said to endure heat and stress, and Stonevault troggs sometimes carry flakes.

sections.title: A Metal Worth Testing
sections.body: Martek the Exiled stays in the Badlands for more than solitude. He thinks indurium might suit Fizzle's car because it is said to endure heat and stress. He wants samples for a test, with the forge ready.

sections.title: Flakes from the Troggs
sections.body: True indurium ore lies deep in Uldaman, but Stonevault troggs in the Badlands sometimes carry flakes. Martek asks for ten. The troggs roam the south-east slope of a rocky clump at Agmond's End, just south of the Valley of Fangs.

sections.title: The Forge Test
sections.body: Martek heats the flakes in his forge, raising the heat in stages. They hold firm, and he swears by Orgrim that indurium can withstand massive heat. The test succeeds. Martek calls the metal amazing stuff.

faq.q: Who sends you after the indurium?
faq.answer: Martek the Exiled, in the central Badlands, asks for indurium samples. The chain to him begins with Fizzle Brassbolts at the Mirage Raceway in Thousand Needles.
Martek thinks indurium might suit Fizzle's car because it is said to endure heat and stress. He wants samples to test in his forge.

faq.q: Where can the indurium flakes be found?
faq.answer: Stonevault troggs in the Badlands sometimes carry indurium flakes. They roam the south-east slope of a rocky clump at Agmond's End, just south of the Valley of Fangs.

faq.q: Where does true indurium ore come from?
faq.answer: Martek says true indurium ore lies deep in Uldaman.
Martek the Exiled comes first in the chain, which begins with Fizzle Brassbolts at the Mirage Raceway.

faq.q: What comes after the flakes are delivered?
faq.answer: The chain continues with News for Fizzle.
